game_title: Patrol Decision Tree – Cliffside Fort Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Coastal Port – Cliffside Fort, a fort on the sea cliffs: the fisher must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Patrol Decision Tree: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions.
theme: Coastal Port – Cliffside Fort: a fort on the sea cliffs
core_gameplay_loop: In Cliffside Fort, repeat each round: Program a guard-evasion decision tree using nested conditions. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the cover value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about cover to power up the fisher and open the sea wall.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 6 (applied tier): Patrol Decision Tree
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Patrol Decision Tree' (Week 3 slot 15), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Cliffside Fort'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cover changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Cliffside Fort.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 12.
